verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs say it indexes your shared files: PDF, Word, markdown, org-mode, plaintext, Notion and GitHub repos. It keeps them in sync through the desktop, Obsidian and Emacs clients and uses them to answer chat queries. Agents can also be given custom knowledge, and community users confirm local document search works, though one hands-on report found poor retrieval for Slovene notes. Missing for 10: evidence that answers cite or link their source passages to show grounding, and independent corroboration of chat answer quality (including for non-English content).
